manifest.description: Send audio to a VBAN receiver over UDP (PCM 16/24-bit).

host.label: VBAN receiver IPv4 address
host.description: IPv4 address of the device receiving audio.

stream_name.label: VBAN stream name
stream_name.description: 1–16 printable ASCII characters; must match the receiver exactly.

packet_frames.label: Audio frames per packet
packet_frames.description: Clamped to the VBAN datagram limit (239 for 24-bit stereo).

user.title: VBAN receiver
user.description: Enter the receiver's unicast IPv4 address. Enable its incoming VBAN stream and use exactly the same stream name, UDP port and audio format.

errors.invalid_configuration: Check the IPv4 address, port, sample rate, channels and bit depth. The stream name must contain 1–16 printable ASCII characters.
